vectors.description: USP default heat of activation divided by the gas constant.
vectors.note: The engine uses R = 8.314462618 J/(mol K) (CODATA); with that R, 83144 / R = 9999.92 K. The 10,000 K identity holds only with the USP value R = 8.3144e-3 kJ/(mol K).

vectors.description: Mean kinetic temperature of five equal-interval readings with the default heat of activation.

tolerance.basis: note's suggested tolerance 0.05 degC against the published 14.9
